GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2025-04-01T18:17:03Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: README Suggestion: Unity *needs to be* in focus or tools may time out
Description: According to my testing (Mac / Apple Silicon), essentially all of the tools rely on the Unity window being in focus to execute, potentially because its main thread heavily throttles function calls if the application is not in focus. In other words, you might see the tool requests time out UNLESS you switch back to Unity to let them execute.

Marking "Run in Background" seems to only affect builds, as far as I can tell, and doesn't help.  

There may be a way around this, but for now, everyone using this should know this limitation.

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
